title: KiCad
acceptance_criteria: The repo has one or more of the following: 1) files with extensions for KiCad projects, schematics, PCBs, symbol libraries, or footprint libraries, 2) plugins that assist KiCad, 3) software utilities that accept and/or generate files for KiCad, 4) skills or MCPs that allow an AI or LLM to work with KiCad. Reject personal portfolio pages and pages with lists having many links to non-KiCad items.

title: SKiDL
acceptance_criteria: The repo has one or more of the following: 1) Python files that use the skidl package to describe an electronic system, 2) software that accepts and/or generates SKiDL or uses SKiDL as part of its operations, 3) skills or MCPs that allow an AI or LLM to work with SKiDL. Reject personal portfolio pages and pages that are mostly lists/tables of links to non-SKiDL projects.

title: FOSS Chips
search_terms: SKYWATER OR GF180MCU OR openlane OR wafer.space

title: Embedded RTOSes
search_terms: FreeRTOS OR NuttX OR Zephyr OR RIOT

title: Kendryte Microcontrollers
search_terms: maix OR kendryte OR K210 OR K230 OR K510
acceptance_criteria: The repo has one or more of the following that involve these microcontrollers: 1) source code files that target one or more of them 2) software utilities for working with them, 3) descriptive or executable files for building electronic or physical systems that contain them 4) skills or MCPs that allow an AI or LLM to work or design with them. Reject personal portfolio pages and pages with lists having many links to projects unrelated to Kendryte microcontrollers.
